description: Gate aircraft at the entrance to Mostar airport carrying the Yugoslav tactical number 60143; the Slovene Soko 522 type survivor list records it as painted in USAF markings probably left over from the film Kelly's Heroes which was shot in Yugoslavia using Soko 522s standing in for wartime types; the false USAF markings are the reason the type is so often misidentified in photographs; built by Soko at Mostar which is where it now stands; served Yugoslavia
